# AGENTS.md for Empirical Legal Scholars

> A general AGENTS.md for empirical legal research: standing instructions for AI coding agents working with empirical legal scholars. It assumes no folder layout. Versions 0.0.x are comment drafts; each published version is a frozen snapshot, and the draft changes often.

- [AGENTS.md, latest published version (save in a project folder as AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md)](latest/AGENTS.md)
- [All published versions](versions.json)
- [Working draft](draft/AGENTS.md)
